summary: Richard Heffernan of Gortnahoe, County Tipperary, husband of Anastasia Boney; John's 4th-great-grand-uncle.
bio: Richard Heffernan was baptized at Gortnahoe, County Tipperary, Ireland, on 3 May 1806, a son of Humphrey Heffernan and Anastasia Ryan. He married Anastasia Boney at Gortnahoe on 12 February 1827, and the couple lived at Mardyke; the baptisms of their children record the parents familiarly as "Dick Heffernan and Anty Boney". He died in Ireland. He was John's 4th-great-grand-uncle.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
